acceptance: Strict typed Campaign stage binds collection, authenticated evaluation index, accepted runtime and exact panel/decoder/seed.
Native CPU generation retains raw text and completion token IDs; empty, repetitive and failed observations remain descriptive.
Immutable per-prompt attempt journals prevent rerolls after interruption or concurrent invocation.
Checkpoint, index, runtime, declaration, decoder, output and journal mismatches are rejected.
Stable runtime identity excludes volatile discovery timestamps and memory counters; stable environment drift is rejected.
Campaign replay preserves readiness bytes and does not dispatch new training or promote a model.

validation.command: uv run --locked --extra cpu sparselab readiness smoke --family dense --output /workspace/panel-final-smoke/readiness

broader_ci: Full local CPU run and exact final-head hosted CI are reported separately in the draft PR; focused acceptance is not a claim that baseline CI is green.
limitations: No accelerator hardware execution; native-engine forwarding has mock coverage only.
No scientific MODEL-0 generation, training campaign, quality result or promotion is claimed.
Research declarations and artifacts remain unchanged.
A native exception exposes no partial trajectory; unavailable text/token IDs are null with the error retained.
